intro.text: An ancient, lavish mansion in Kholinar, named for the fountains in its atrium whose falling water was Soulcast into solid crystal, wood and stone.

description.text: The mansion is four storeys of solid stone around a square atrium under a skylight, with galleries on every floor. The atrium is planted with tended shalebark and rockbuds, where many lifespren drift.

Four great fountains once fell from the top floor to the atrium floor. Each was Soulcast just as the water struck the ground, into crystal, dark wood, marble and other materials, fixing its shape for good. They are the house's most famous feature.

Close to the atrium stairs on the first floor is a library. Further along the same corridor is the larder, behind a door with a combination lock, with two dumbwaiters down to a ground-floor loading bay large enough for carriages. A gate shuts the courtyard off from the street.

items.text: The house has passed through more than a dozen owners. One of them paid a fortune to have its real waterfalls Soulcast, and from then on it was called Rockfall. Its latest owner bought it about ten years before the siege of Kholinar and tried to rename it Hadinal Keep, but the name never caught on. Brightness Nananav runs the household, controlling its servants, guards, furnishings and money.

Everstorm lightning blew a large hole in a room beside the atrium, ruining a costly Shin carpet. Shallan and her team posed as workers hired for the repairs, emptied the larder and handed the food out to the city's poor, hoping to catch the eye of the Cult of Moments.
